source: Etsy's listing form (Shop Manager → Listings → Add a listing), read from Etsy's help center and Open API v3 on 2026-11-08. No signed-in browser was available, so the layout below is not yet a form sweep.

sources.categories: Etsy seller taxonomy leaves (ids are Etsy taxonomy_id) from Anteroom's category tree seed, read 2026-09-15. List checks the leaf against Etsy's live taxonomy.
sources.attribute_rows: Built per category from getPropertiesByTaxonomyId (services/marketplace_schemas.py etsy_properties), never kept here.

unconfirmed: Which fields share a row. Item weight beside Item size is a guess; every other row is full width.
Required markers on the page. Required here follows createDraftListing (title, description, price, quantity, who_made, when_made, taxonomy_id) and photos.
Helper text under each field. The help lines here paraphrase Etsy's help center, not the page.
The on-page option labels for What is it? and When was it made? (these are Vendoo's labels, mapped to Etsy's codes on List).
Whether When was it made? sits in the Category tab (help center) or under How it's made (2026 seller reports).
Whether free-text Materials sits under Attributes and whether Styles is still on the form.
Field order inside Pricing & shipping beyond its two sub-headings.

fields.help: Add up to 20 photos and 1 video.

fields.label: Category
fields.help: Search for the most specific category that fits your item.

fields.label: What type of item is it?
fields.help: Anteroom lists physical items. Prepare digital files in Etsy Shop Manager.

fields.label: Title
fields.help: Include keywords buyers would use to search for your item. Etsy takes %, :, & and + once each.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: What makes your item special? Buyers see the first few lines unless they expand it.

fields.group_help: Buyers often use these details to find the perfect item.

fields.label: Materials
fields.help: Up to 13. Letters, numbers and spaces only.

fields.label: Tags
fields.help: Add up to 13 tags to help people search for your listings.

fields.label: Processing profile
fields.help: Set in Settings → Connections → Etsy. Anteroom sends this to every new Etsy draft.

fields.label: Shipping option
fields.help: Set in Settings → Connections → Etsy. Anteroom sends this to every new Etsy draft.

fields.label: Item weight
fields.help: Change the package in Item Details.

fields.label: Item size (when packed)
fields.help: Length × width × height. Change the package in Item Details.

fields.label: Returns and exchanges
fields.help: Set in Settings → Connections → Etsy. Anteroom sends this to every new Etsy draft.

fields.label: What is it?
options: A supply or tool to make things

fields.label: Renewal options
fields.help: Anteroom saves Etsy drafts with manual renewal. Change it in Etsy before publishing if you want it renewed.

not_offered.label: Variations
not_offered.reason: Anteroom's Etsy send writes one product; it cannot create variations.

not_offered.label: Custom options
not_offered.reason: Personalization is a separate Etsy call (updateListingPersonalization) that Anteroom does not make.

not_offered.label: SKU
not_offered.reason: Etsy takes SKU through the inventory call, which Anteroom does not write on a new draft.

not_offered.label: GPSR manufacturer and safety information
not_offered.reason: EEA and Northern Ireland sellers only; not sent by Anteroom.

not_offered.label: Feature this listing
not_offered.reason: Etsy's API has no field for it.

not_offered.label: Styles
not_offered.reason: Unconfirmed on the current page. Generated styles are still sent when the listing has them.
